description: Six illustrative project-derived trace chains, now linked to a draft source-derived checklist. Not exhaustive; no dialysis tests executed.

needs.statement: Operate the simulated machine without access to simulation internals
Preserve protective authority during control faults
Distinguish HDF fluid exchange from patient weight change
Respond to invalid measurements without assuming they are safe
Model online substitution preparation with declared limits

designs.description: Separate application identities and enforced device/admin interface boundaries.
Protection issues requests directly to plant actuator arbitration; latching/reset logic is separate from control.
Conserved fluid/solute exchange between patient, circuit and dialyzer; independent balance observer.
Separate sensor channels with timestamps/sequence/validity; explicit simulation-clock and liveness policies.
LVGL renders authoritative alarm state; protection owns hazard/action state; UI submits validated operator requests.
Mixing/heating/filtration/route models expose measurements and test outcomes; no direct protective access to hidden contamination truth.

requirements.statement: Device UI access shall be restricted to permitted machine command and telemetry interfaces.
requirements.acceptance: Calls from the device-ui identity to patient/scenario administration are denied; permitted treatment requests remain available.
unresolved: Select transport/identity mechanism and endpoint policy.
requirements.normative_mapping: Draft links in standards/checklist.json: SEC-013, PRJ-002. Applicability and adequacy remain unreviewed.

requirements.statement: Control commands shall not override an active protective constraint at actuator arbitration.
requirements.acceptance: For every approved active protection state, all conflicting control commands preserve the specified protective outputs until the approved reset sequence completes.
unresolved: Complete hazard-specific outputs, recovery rules and response-time budgets.
requirements.normative_mapping: Draft links in standards/checklist.json: GEN-018, PRJ-003. Applicability and adequacy remain unreviewed.

requirements.statement: Fluid accounting shall separately track gross membrane transfer, substitution, other inputs/outputs and circuit storage.
requirements.acceptance: Patient and whole-system fluid-balance residuals stay within independently justified tolerances in HD and both HDF routes, including substitution interruption.
unresolved: Define solver, uncertainty budget, tolerances and independent oracle.
requirements.normative_mapping: Draft links in standards/checklist.json: HD-021, PRJ-005. Applicability and adequacy remain unreviewed.

requirements.statement: Protection shall evaluate measurement validity and age and apply the approved hazard-specific response to unusable data.
requirements.acceptance: All invalidity/staleness cases trigger the specified response within the allocated detection/action budget; paused virtual time follows its documented semantics.
unresolved: Derive validity rules, clock policy and justified response bounds.
requirements.normative_mapping: Draft links in standards/checklist.json: HD-027, HD-033. Applicability and adequacy remain unreviewed.

requirements.statement: Alarm acknowledgment or permitted silence shall not by itself clear an active hazardous condition or protective constraint.
requirements.acceptance: Each alarm follows its reviewed priority/state/silence/reset specification; a continuing hazard retains the required protective outputs.
unresolved: Complete alarm catalog, timing, audio delivery and critical-task usability evaluation.
requirements.normative_mapping: Draft links in standards/checklist.json: HD-026, HD-038. Applicability and adequacy remain unreviewed.

requirements.statement: Substitution delivery shall be conditioned on approved preparation and observable integrity criteria.
requirements.acceptance: All specified preparation/integrity failures with modeled observable evidence produce the approved response; unobservable failures are identified as detection gaps.
unresolved: Define chemistry/integrity models, sensors/tests, acceptance envelope and residual detection limitations.
requirements.normative_mapping: Draft links in standards/checklist.json: HD-030. Applicability and adequacy remain unreviewed.

tests.procedure: Attempt patient edits, fault injection and simulation clock changes from the device-ui identity; repeat from the authorized external console.
tests.expected: Device identity requests are denied; authorized console requests are recorded and allowed.

tests.procedure: Inject each approved protection state and conflicting control commands, including control restart and duplicate messages.
tests.expected: Protective outputs persist; reset only follows the approved hazard-specific conditions.

tests.procedure: Run zero-removal, constant-flow, pre/post HDF and interrupted-substitution scenarios against independently derived balances.
tests.expected: Recorded balances agree with the independent oracle within predeclared tolerances.

tests.procedure: Inject stale, missing, reordered, invalid and biased measurements; pause/accelerate the simulation and separately kill a process.
tests.expected: Responses match the approved fault policy, with measured timing and no mistaken pause-induced result.

tests.procedure: Acknowledge and silence persistent alarms, disconnect the UI and attempt invalid resets.
tests.expected: Protective behavior and displayed/alarm-delivery state match the approved alarm catalog.

tests.procedure: Inject composition, thermal, route and integrity faults, including faults without a corresponding measurement/test signal.
tests.expected: Observable cases follow the protective policy; unobservable cases are not falsely reported as detected or proof of sterility.
